text:
mina: heads-up — after the runtime unpin to v4.0.0 in us-west we started seeing intermittent plugin_loader_timeout on a small fraction of toolcall requests (canary cohort). opening thread to coordinate a pinback if needed.

deploybot: [automated] action=unpin_runtime runtime=v4.0.0 scope=us-west user=mina run_id=rb-5102 started=1845000800

toby: looking at metrics now. plugin_loader_timeout ~0.9% over last 7m on canary, p99 latency +15%. overall traffic for canary ~2.2% of region.

yara: SDK team — any ABI/handshake changes in v4.0.0?

drew: yes, v4.0.0 flips to the async plugin handshake by default. older SDKs will fall back, but some clients hit a race condition and raise loader timeouts. SDK fix is non-trivial (~4h).

ops-ravi: options: 1) pin canary back to v3.9.8 (fast), 2) toggle runtime compatibility flag for canary (if available), 3) keep unpinned and accept small error. I'm for canary pin until SDK patch.

maya: support estimate: impact ~0.1% of global requests, mostly tool-heavy prompts. Customers with heavy tool usage might notice.

mina: can we do a scoped pin to avoid touching other regions? prefer minimal blast radius.

ops-ravi: applying a scoped pinlist override. snippet:
```
runtime_pins:
  us-west:
    cohort: canary
    runtime: v3.9.8
```

ops-ravi: executing: /deploybot pin runtime v3.9.8 --scope=us-west --cohort=canary --reason "plugin_loader_timeout after v4.0.0 unpin"

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v3.9.8 scope=us-west cohort=canary user=ops-ravi run_id=rb-5102 status=started ts=1845001205

ops-ravi: pinned canary. monitoring 10m. will not extend to prod without +1 from release lead.

toby: 5m in: plugin_loader_timeout down to 0.05%, p99 back to baseline. logs show no further race traces.

drew: confirm: SDK logs no handshake errors when pinned to v3.9.8. I'll prioritize the async handshake fix and open PR (PR #8244).

yara: adding a lightweight preflight that exercises async handshake on canary before unpin next time. will add to release doc.

mina: plan: keep canary pinned, block further unpins in the change window, schedule a gradual unpin only after SDK PR merges and canary smoke passes. tagging INC-5102.

maya: internal note sent. customer comms drafted but held.

ops-ravi: /deploybot summary run_id=rb-5102 actions=unpin(v4.0.0,us-west)->pin(v3.9.8,us-west canary) status=canary-pin duration=185s

mina: thanks all. follow-ups: @drew SDK PR (#8244), @yara add handshake smoke (INC-5102-2), @toby monitor canary for 24h. closing thread for now.
